speaker: 白
jp:
{ruby:隠人|お　に}の気配は五つ……。
目には見えぬが、近くにおる。
en:
I sense five Oni... They cannot be seen, but they are
near.

speaker: 白
jp:
カミフダとの同化が進み、
現し身を失ったか……。
en:
Their fusion with the cards has progressed, and they
have lost their physical forms...

speaker: 白
jp:
{px}よ、
{ruby:徒人|ただびと}の眼で追っては討てぬぞ。
ならばどうするか―――
en:
{px}, you cannot strike them down if you track them
with an ordinary person's eyes. So what to do--
